method: weight = mean of two percentiles in [0,1]: the OpenAlex cited_by_count percentile inside the cohort of same decade, document type and language (widened when a cohort holds fewer than 8 works), and the percentile of a PageRank run on graph.json. A work with no citation datum keeps the structural percentile alone and is marked nc.
citation_source: cited_by_count from data/derived/citations.jsonl when the working table is present, otherwise data/citation-counts.json; joined on the ixtheo-k10plus PPN, then on the DOI. No title join.
